node.title: Re: Math:Bigint module install issue on win 7 32 bit
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [nutcr0cker],

[doc://Math::BigInt] should already be part of a standard Strawberry Perl distribution, you should be able to just [doc://use] it.

Otherwise, please see [id://174051] and post a [http://www.sscce.org/|Short, Self Contained, Correct Example] that reproduces the problem, as well as the exact error message.

Regards,
-- Hauke D
